page.overview:
What is Revavroom?

Revavroom is a vehicular Pokémon with a primarily black body. It has four black wheels and a silver engine attached to its body. Eight exhaust pipes stick out of the engine, with each pipe covered in a purple liquid, which it could be poison. the six exhaust pipes are smaller and stick out of the longer exhaust pipes. Revavroom also has a single yellow eye in front of the engine. On top of Revavroom's engine is a large cylindrical mouth armed with a pair of sharp teeth.

Revavroom uses its loud engine to scare off enemies. It absorbs minerals and poisonous gases inside its engine in order to produce energy before detonating the energy from its eight cylinders.

Revavroom possesses a long tongue that it uses to spray toxic fluids. It can also function as a power source by plugging into machines, which Ortega used by creating unique Starmobile forms for it. Additionally, Revavroom's Starmobile forms are also capable of using the moves Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Magical Torque, Noxious Torque, and Wicked Torque.

Revavroom evolves from Varoom starting at level 40.
